evals.prompt: Add reverse charge (snudd avregning) for services purchased from a foreign supplier.
evals.expected_output: Both VAT legs posted in the single status-driven posting function, codes from the SAF-T lists, covered by an exhaustive case test and a fast-check balance property.
assertions: Both VAT legs (computed output and deductible input) are posted, not netted to a single line
The branch is added in the single status-driven posting function, not as scattered status conditionals
VAT codes and accounts are taken from the committed SAF-T lists, not hardcoded from memory
A fast-check property test asserts the voucher balances (sum debit = sum credit) for all amounts

evals.prompt: Representation expenses must have non-deductible input VAT regardless of the org's MVA status.
evals.expected_output: Representation input VAT folded into the expense (non-deductible) with an exhaustive table test and no hardcoded codes.
assertions: Input VAT for representation is treated as non-deductible (added to the expense), independent of MVA status
An exhaustive table test covers the representation case
No VAT code or account number is hardcoded from memory
